nodes.name: Coordination Engine
nodes.purpose: The operational runtime that moves workers and requests through their lifecycles, governed entirely by the Policy layer.
nodes.ux_intent: The beating heart of the platform. Users see status bars moving left to right effortlessly, completely hiding the complex state transitions underneath.
nodes.vertical_notes: Manages the high-anxiety moments (is the nanny confirmed?) and the logistical hurdles (is the cleaner on their way?).
nodes.case_integration: This IS the state machine executing the Cases in the Portfolio.

nodes.name: Worker State Machine
nodes.purpose: Tracks the lifecycle of a worker from applicant to active, through breaks, to inactive.
nodes.ux_intent: Admins see clear 'Active/Inactive' badges. Workers just toggle their availability on their app.
nodes.vertical_notes: Caregivers have strict vetting states before becoming 'active'. Cleaners might have faster onboarding but frequent 'on_break' periods.

nodes.name: Vet Worker
nodes.purpose: Transitions a worker from applicant to vetted once all credential taxonomy requirements are met.
nodes.ux_intent: A satisfying checklist that turns green and unlocks the 'Approve' button.
nodes.vertical_notes: Nanny vetting requires 2 references and DBS. Cleaning might just require Right to Work and basic DBS.

nodes.name: Activate Worker
nodes.purpose: Makes a vetted worker eligible for matching and assignments.
nodes.ux_intent: A celebratory moment; worker gets an SMS 'You are live!'.
nodes.vertical_notes: Now they appear in the proximity matching algorithms and shortlists.

nodes.name: Suspend Worker
nodes.purpose: Temporarily removes a worker from matching due to quality threshold breaches or compliance expiry.
nodes.ux_intent: Immediate safety switch to protect clients, auto-cancelling pending assignments gracefully.
nodes.vertical_notes: Critical for safeguarding if a nanny's DBS expires. They cannot be placed anywhere.
nodes.case_integration: Auto-fails or detaches them from active Cases.

nodes.name: Reactivate Worker
nodes.purpose: Returns a suspended or inactive worker back to the active pool.
nodes.ux_intent: One-click 'Welcome back' action.
nodes.vertical_notes: Used when the updated DBS certificate is finally provided.

nodes.name: Deactivate Worker
nodes.purpose: Permanently offboards a worker from the agency.
nodes.ux_intent: Clean severance of access, archiving their profile securely.
nodes.vertical_notes: Worker retires or leaves the agency.

nodes.name: Declare Availability
nodes.purpose: Worker sets their standard working hours or specific available days.
nodes.ux_intent: A calendar UI in the worker app: swipe across days to mark 'Available'. Zero typing.
nodes.vertical_notes: Nannies provide hourly blocks (e.g., 'Mon-Wed 8am-6pm'). Cleaners declare whole days and postcodes.
nodes.case_integration: Matching engine queries this schedule for availability overlaps.

nodes.name: Declare Break
nodes.purpose: Worker registers a period of unavailability (illness, holiday, maternity).
nodes.ux_intent: Two taps: 'I am sick today' -> auto-notifies admin and handles replacements.
nodes.vertical_notes: Triggers the replacement logic for any long-term jobs they hold during that window.
nodes.case_integration: Instantly triggers 'Vacancy Detected' in affected Cases.

nodes.name: Set Long Term Placement
nodes.purpose: Marks a worker as being engaged in a permanent or long-term job, removing them from general availability.
nodes.ux_intent: A toggle that effectively says 'They are off the market for now'.
nodes.vertical_notes: Live-in nannies stay in this state for years. Once they leave the job, they return to 'active' pool.

nodes.name: View Availability Live
nodes.purpose: Allows admin to see exactly who is available right now or at a specific future time.
nodes.ux_intent: A live, color-coded heat map of the agency's workforce capacity. Beautiful and instant.
nodes.vertical_notes: Essential for dispatching emergency cover quickly.

nodes.name: Request State Machine
nodes.purpose: Manages the lifecycle of a client's request from intent to closure.
nodes.ux_intent: Like a pizza tracker for your booking. 'Request Received -> Finding Match -> Nanny Confirmed -> Job Complete'.
nodes.vertical_notes: Anonymous clients can drop a request in 'open', convert to an account, and watch it move to 'confirmed'.
nodes.case_integration: This represents the macro-status of a Case.

nodes.name: Open Request
nodes.purpose: Captures the client's raw need before matching begins.
nodes.ux_intent: A seamless form submission: 'I need a deep clean next Tuesday'.
nodes.vertical_notes: Anon users can open requests. Nanny requests gather ages; cleaning gathers bedrooms.
nodes.case_integration: Instantiates a new Case in the system.

nodes.name: Match Request
nodes.purpose: Transitions request into matching phase based on policy rules.
nodes.ux_intent: System takes over: 'We are finding your perfect match'.
nodes.vertical_notes: Invokes the matching algorithm (auto-assign or shortlist).

nodes.name: Schedule Request
nodes.purpose: Locks in the proposed time and worker, pending final confirmation.
nodes.ux_intent: Visual calendar lock-in.
nodes.vertical_notes: Worker has agreed, now waiting for client to confirm (high-trust nannying) or just moving forward (cleaning).

nodes.name: Confirm Request
nodes.purpose: Client officially accepts the assigned worker, locking the booking.
nodes.ux_intent: A delightful 'Confirm Booking' button that solidifies the commitment.
nodes.vertical_notes: Vital for nannies: parents want to see the profile and explicitly say 'Yes, I want Jane'.
nodes.case_integration: Case is now locked and ready for execution.

nodes.name: Start Job
nodes.purpose: Transitions the request to in-progress when the actual work begins.
nodes.ux_intent: Status flips to 'In Progress' automatically when worker checks in.
nodes.vertical_notes: Crucial for cleaning to track actual time spent. For live-in nannies, this just marks the start date.

nodes.name: Complete Request
nodes.purpose: Marks the work as finished, triggering invoicing and review collection.
nodes.ux_intent: A celebratory finish: 'Job done! Rate your experience'.
nodes.vertical_notes: Triggers billing engine according to payment policy.

nodes.name: Close Request
nodes.purpose: Finalizes the request after all administrative tasks (payment, reviews) are done.
nodes.ux_intent: Silent archival. The file is neatly put away.
nodes.vertical_notes: Closes the loop for one-off jobs. Recurring jobs just spawn a new child request.

nodes.name: Cancel Request
nodes.purpose: Aborts the request before or during the process.
nodes.ux_intent: Clear cancellation with zero confusion about whether a worker is still coming.
nodes.vertical_notes: May trigger cancellation fees per payment rules.

nodes.name: Assignment State Machine
nodes.purpose: Tracks the micro-lifecycle of a specific worker being attached to a request.
nodes.ux_intent: Tinder for jobs. Proposed -> Accepted -> Confirmed -> Checked-in -> Done.
nodes.vertical_notes: A single request might cycle through multiple assignments if workers decline or clients reject.
nodes.case_integration: Represents the inner loop of a Case.

nodes.name: Propose Assignment
nodes.purpose: Sends a job offer to a worker.
nodes.ux_intent: Push notification: 'New job offer! Tap to view details'.
nodes.vertical_notes: Cleaners get address and hours. Nannies get kid ages and special requirements.

nodes.name: Worker Accept
nodes.purpose: Worker agrees to take the proposed job.
nodes.ux_intent: Big green 'Accept' button in the app.
nodes.vertical_notes: If 'auto-assign' is on, this might automatically confirm the request.

nodes.name: Client Confirm
nodes.purpose: Client agrees to the proposed worker.
nodes.ux_intent: Client sees 'Jane accepted! Confirm Jane?'.
nodes.vertical_notes: High trust step. If policy says 'auto-assign' (cleaning), the system does this on the client's behalf immediately.

nodes.name: Worker Check In
nodes.purpose: Worker logs their arrival at the job site.
nodes.ux_intent: One tap 'I'm here', securely logging GPS.
nodes.vertical_notes: Critical for hourly domestic cleaners. Less relevant for live-in nannies.

nodes.name: Worker Check Out
nodes.purpose: Worker logs the end of the job, capturing actual time worked.
nodes.ux_intent: One tap 'Job complete', with optional notes.
nodes.vertical_notes: Calculates overtime rules here if parents were late.

nodes.name: Decline Assignment
nodes.purpose: Worker refuses the proposed job.
nodes.ux_intent: 'Pass' button, quietly routing to the next worker.
nodes.vertical_notes: Workers can decline if travel is too far or they don't like the client history.

nodes.name: Rematch on Decline
nodes.purpose: Automatically attempts to find the next best candidate when a proposal is declined.
nodes.ux_intent: Self-healing logistics. Admin doesn't lift a finger.
nodes.vertical_notes: For cleaning, it instantly pings the next cleaner in the radius.

nodes.name: Admin Cancel Assignment
nodes.purpose: Admin forcefully un-assigns a worker due to emergency or policy breach.
nodes.ux_intent: Emergency ripcord that cleans up the mess politely.
nodes.vertical_notes: Used if a nanny's DBS check fails on the morning of a job.

nodes.name: Client Cancel Assignment
nodes.purpose: Client cancels the specific worker but keeps the request open, or cancels entirely.
nodes.ux_intent: 'Please send someone else' button.
nodes.vertical_notes: If a client had a bad trial with a cleaner, they cancel the assignment and ask for a rematch.

nodes.name: Matching Operations
nodes.purpose: Executes the logic defined in policy to pair workers with requests.
nodes.ux_intent: The brain doing the hard work so the users don't have to.
nodes.vertical_notes: Handles the core difference in how Nanny and Cleaning agencies operate their assignments.

nodes.name: Filter Candidates
nodes.purpose: Reduces the total pool of workers to only those who meet hard requirements (credentials, availability, service type).
nodes.ux_intent: Invisible strict bouncer.
nodes.vertical_notes: Filters out cleaners without COSHH for commercial jobs, or nannies without Pediatric First Aid for infants.

nodes.name: Auto Assign Candidate
nodes.purpose: Automatically picks the top-scored candidate and proposes the assignment instantly.
nodes.ux_intent: Zero-touch fulfillment. The agency runs itself while the admin sleeps.
nodes.vertical_notes: The primary mode for cleaning agencies.

nodes.name: Present Shortlist to Client
nodes.purpose: Provides the top N candidates to the client to make the final choice.
nodes.ux_intent: A beautiful carousel of 3 highly qualified professionals. 'Choose your favorite'.
nodes.vertical_notes: The primary mode for Nanny agencies. Parents want choice, but curated choice.

nodes.name: Client Browse Portfolio
nodes.purpose: Allows clients to view all available workers and request someone specific.
nodes.ux_intent: Like browsing Airbnb for people. High autonomy.
nodes.vertical_notes: Often used for babysitting where clients browse profiles based on hobbies and languages.

nodes.name: Admin Manual Assign
nodes.purpose: Bypasses all algorithms, allowing an admin to force a specific worker onto a job.
nodes.ux_intent: The 'I know best' override switch for seasoned agency owners.
nodes.vertical_notes: Essential for bespoke placements (e.g., VIP clients where the admin handles everything offline and just records it).

nodes.name: Apply Continuity Preference
nodes.purpose: Checks if the client has had this service before and heavily weights their previous worker.
nodes.ux_intent: Invisible magic that says 'We know you loved Jane, we're sending her again'.
nodes.vertical_notes: Make-or-break feature for recurring domestic cleaning. Clients hate retraining new cleaners.

nodes.name: Apply Proximity Sorting
nodes.purpose: Calculates travel distance between worker's zone and the job site.
nodes.ux_intent: Behind-the-scenes math ensuring no worker gets a job 2 hours away by mistake.
nodes.vertical_notes: Cleaning operates on margins; travel time eats margins. Proximity is heavily weighted.

nodes.name: Replacement Operations
nodes.purpose: Handles the complex logic of swapping workers when a long-term or recurring commitment breaks.
nodes.ux_intent: Turning a crisis (sick nanny) into a seamless customer service win.
nodes.vertical_notes: The primary pain point for agencies is managing absences.

nodes.name: Detect Vacancy
nodes.purpose: Identifies that an upcoming scheduled job no longer has a valid worker due to break declaration or suspension.
nodes.ux_intent: An early warning radar detecting issues before the client even notices.
nodes.vertical_notes: Cleaner calls in sick for Tuesday -> detects 3 affected Tuesday cleans.
nodes.case_integration: Flags Cases red on the admin dashboard instantly.

nodes.name: Find Replacement
nodes.purpose: Automatically spins up the matching engine to find a sub with identical skills.
nodes.ux_intent: Machine speed recovery. 'Found a replacement in 4 seconds'.
nodes.vertical_notes: Ensures the replacement also has Paediatric First aid if the sick nanny had it.

nodes.name: Notify Client of Replacement
nodes.purpose: Proactively messages the client about the change before they discover it.
nodes.ux_intent: White-glove service message: 'Hi! Mary is unwell, so we've arranged for Sarah to cover your clean today. Same time!'
nodes.vertical_notes: If policy is 'auto-sub', it just informs them. If policy is 'ask', it prompts them to approve.

nodes.name: Approve Replacement
nodes.purpose: Client agrees to the proposed substitute worker.
nodes.ux_intent: One tap: 'Sarah looks great, approve'.
nodes.vertical_notes: Parents rarely accept random replacements for childcare without viewing a profile first.
